facts.business: NMDC Steel Limited operates a 3.0 MTPA integrated steel plant at Nagarnar, Chhattisgarh, producing hot rolled coils and other steel products using high-grade iron ore from NMDC's Bailadila mines.

capacity_or_capex.item: 3.0 MTPA Integrated Steel Plant at Nagarnar
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Commissioned in 2023; commercial production of HR Coils commenced 31 August 2023

guidance_or_targets.statement: Ambition to create a resilient steel enterprise contributing to India's industrial growth through technology, capability and responsible progress

auditor.name: Independent Auditors (not explicitly named in excerpts)

key_risks: High dependence on coal and power drives operational cost volatility and emissions
Steel plants require large water volumes; risk of scarcity and regulatory constraints
Large waste generation can create environmental liabilities
Strict environmental norms; non-compliance can halt operations
Steel operations involve high-risk working environments (high temperature, heavy machinery)
Dependence on iron ore, coal, lime & dolomite logistics; disruptions can impact production continuity
High logistics costs due to bulk material handling and heavy reliance on rail transportation
Commodity price volatility and trade policy instability
Regulatory and ESG risks from carbon-intensive BF-BOF route emissions (Scope 1 & 2)
facts.related_party_note: NSL has entered into an agreement with Steel Authority of India Ltd (SAIL) for sale of its products. Products are sold initially on provisional price issued by SAIL; actual price decided by a Technical and Procurement Committee (TPC) with nominated members from NSL & SAIL. Revenue recognized based on provisional price in absence of final price. KMPs and Functional Directors are from NMDC Ltd. on co-terminus basis and draw no remuneration from NSL.
